jobs.title: Loss Prevention Leader: Shrink Reduction & Training Lead
jobs.description:
Kohl's is seeking a Loss Prevention Supervisor for its Texas stores to reduce shrink and improve profitability. You will lead external and internal theft deterrence efforts, investigations, and training for store teams, while partnering with management and law enforcement as needed.

You will oversee audits and security inspections, promote a culture of honesty and control, and recruit/train Loss Prevention staff across locations as assigned.
